nodes.label: Lead arrives
nodes.note: From ads, SEO, referrals or outreach: every source lands in the same place.

nodes.label: Saved in the CRM
nodes.note: Source, city and time zone stored, lead assigned to a team member.

nodes.label: Instant call, text, email
nodes.note: The lead hears back within minutes, before a competitor does.

nodes.label: Booked a call?
nodes.note: Booking calendar on the website, in the chat or by reply.

nodes.label: Nurtured, kept warm
nodes.note: A lead that does not book yet gets short follow-ups by text and email, then stays in a slow value campaign, not in the bin.

nodes.label: Reminders before the call
nodes.note: At once, a day before and 30 minutes before; reschedule in two clicks.

nodes.label: Showed up?
nodes.note: The meeting start decides which path the lead takes.

nodes.label: No-show follow-up
nodes.note: A friendly message and a rebooking link, sent automatically.

nodes.label: Sales call, notes in CRM
nodes.note: Call notes and script live in the CRM; the stage updates itself.

nodes.label: Contract and invoice
nodes.note: Price from the call, contract from a template, invoice right after the e-signature.

nodes.label: Payment reminder
nodes.note: A text and an email with the invoice link.

nodes.label: Client won
nodes.note: The workflow ends and onboarding starts.

nodes.label: Review request
nodes.note: Sent when the project is closed, by text and email.

nodes.label: Rating?
nodes.note: A short rating form decides where the review goes.

nodes.label: Private feedback
nodes.note: 1 to 3 stars go to the team, not to the public page.

nodes.label: Public review page
nodes.note: 4 and 5 stars are sent to the public review page.

nodes.label: Website grows on autopilot
nodes.note: Only the best reviews are public, and a thank-you email goes out.
